partial_document.description: A deliberately incomplete BIM JSON 2.0 document; omissions must be listed in missing_facts or losses.

FEW_SHOTS.condition: A complete rectangular room request needs a Formal semantic graph; example values are not defaults and must not be copied.
A multi-storey request needs storey-local placements, storey-specific walls, and openings/windows hosted by walls on the same storey. Example values are not defaults and must not be copied.
